_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate dominates: no F&G/ETF/funding breaker visible, so skilled call is hold the current Hope rung rather than force a direction.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/coil; narrative inflow + blowoff pattern leans distribution/top risk without a matching forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54, 30d momentum stays low-single-digit drift, funding flat, ETF flows absent
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >62 with expanding ETF inflows and momentum, or F&G <46 on vol spike and range loss
